notes.title: New Gameplay & Competition Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=-eifuPvC_LU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Main Changes:[/h2]

[h3]Complete overhaul of player ship customization: [/h3]
[i]We are still working on this to constantly improve it and we may totally rework it again[/i]
[list]
[*] Simplified ship selection process, each ship has tailored particle effects.
[*] Some ships require XP to unlock.
[*] Animated ship colors.
[/list]
[h3]UI overhaul:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Main menu UI updated to be less confusing and easier to navigate with a controller.
[*] In-game UI is more readable and prettier.
[/list]
[h3]New Hazard: Black Holes.
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Random amounts of black holes spawn on screen and suck in blocks. Players that are caught within its bounds for too long will lose a life.
[/list]
[h3]New Mini-boss: the Cadedonian mini-boss: [/h3]
[list]
[*] 2-4 mini worms spawn and attempt to hit the player. 
[/list]
[h3]New boss: Antheia the Sorceress. [/h3]
[list]
[*] Her specialty is deception, good luck defeating her every 60 waves. 
[/list]
[h3]Hall of Fame: (Score competition on Steam only)[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are introducing a score competition, the player with the highest score after each season's conclusion will win a trophy and spot in our hall of fame, as well as a cash prize which will increase based on 10% of Wavecade's Steam sales.
[*] During the season, players will be able to see the current highest score which is updated daily.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=GyeTZzCj-SU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Reworked Charged Shot:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Charged shot can shoot instantly, but will need to charge automatically when used too often. Charge timings are tweaked.
[/list]
[h3]New Soundtracks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Song names: Le Nova, Horizon, Antheia’s bite, Antheia’s Might, Hall of Fame.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ability to skip dialogue.
[*] Crowd SFX plays when losing a life, when the player receives enough points, and when double/triple/quadruple points powerup is active.
[*] Behemoth boss can take splash damage.
[*] Added support for 16:10 aspect ratio.
[*] Balanced abilities, some last longer, some are shorter.
[*] Removed ‘Armor block’ and ‘Fast track’ game mode, due to lack of popularity.
[*] Powerups now show the next upgrade available.
[*] Multi level point booster (x2, x3, x4) powerups.
[*] Clan wave ships have a stronger variant.
[*] Faster leveling up sequence.
[*] Dynamically scale the main UI as a settings item (50% to 150%).
[*] New block styles.
[*] Able to customize player 2 when player 2 is spawned in a local co-op game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update available for Wavecade v1.4.2
notes.notes:
This update includes stability improvements as well as UI refinements.
Various bugs have been fixed, multiplayer sync is now improved with better reliability. Rooms should not automatically disconnect as the first wave starts. 

There is now a universal leaderboards for all game modes which you can find at [url=http://wavecade.com.au]http://wavecade.com.au[/url]

It is not automatically updated so please let the developer know when this happens.
New challenges are in, giving you a nice boost to XP. This is automatically synced on the Steam Cloud so you'll be able to play on different devices under the same account.

Please email spalatobros@gmail.com if you have any queries, or post your question up in the Steam community, share your scores, or join our Discord and ask the developer anything.

notes.title: Wavecade 1.3 is out!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=fANgFUJQfM0;full][/previewyoutube]

Wavecade 1.3 is out! This time we have lots of content updates, so buckle up.

Unlockable customization: The more you play, the more you unlock:
[list]
[*] Player ships
[*] Propulsion effects
[*] Block sets
[*] Perks
[*] Your shooting sound
[/list]

The matchmaking servers are now updated to allow more matches to be active (up to 10 at a time). Any player on any platform can play with any other player. Now that is awesome!

On top of that, we have overhauled the UI to be crisp and clear for the eye. We fixed a bunch of bugs from v1.2 and is now consistent with all the other ports out on Nintendo Switch/Android/iOS. Be sure to get Wavecade on those platforms too. 

We are looking for user reviews so if you haven't reviewed already, we will appreciate that very much if you do :) Positive or otherwise!

notes.title: Wavecade v1.3: Development in progress!
notes.notes:
Wavecade v1.2 is now complete. Just waiting for other platforms to approve of the new updates before rolling it out. 

In v1.3 we are doing an overhaul on the customization system and updating UI and fonts throughout the game. We will allow players to 3D orbit the ship while customizing it, and give the player more options to choose from when selecting ships/propulsions/colors.

We are adding a 3-slot perks system which give the player enhancements that are permanent throughout the game. Stay tuned to find out what they are.

Other than that we are perfecting the gameplay and fixing bugs as well as improving the performance for the game.

notes.title: Wavecade v1.1 development complete!
notes.notes:
Some users reported some elusive bugs where the next wave does not start and is left in a soft-lock. We have taken action to make sure this doesn't happen in the new update.

There are now 2 new abilities which you can choose in your customization panel. Try find the one that is best for you.

We have overhauled the block spawning system which now recycles assets more efficiently. There have been visual and memory optimizations to achieve glorious framerates for all platforms.

The matchmaking section got some improvement where the game automatically searches for a room to join periodically. Once a valid room is found, the game will join that room. 

We are looking for anyone who plays Wavecade to provide their feedback, what they liked or didn't like and post a review on the Steam page here. We will definitely be listening to your feedback and always looking to balance the game to make it even more fun for everyone.

A full changelog will be shown in the next announcement post when the date for it is confirmed. Hang in there!

notes.title: Wavecade v1.1 In development
notes.notes:
At the moment, the update is 50% complete!

What we have worked on:
[list]
[*] Day 1 bug fixes
[*] Performance optimizations 
[*] New content such as powerups and abilities 
[/list] 
We are currently working on redesigning the UI and changing layouts of menus. We want to get this right so you can get into the game easier.

We will also make another announcement on the release date for the update. 

We have a Nintendo Switch port of the game (out on August 1). If you have purchased the game on Steam and would like the Switch version as well, please email or DM the developer or subscribe on the Wavecade website [url=http://wavecade.ml]here[/url]. 

Then include your proof of your Steam purchase, and we will send you a free Switch key to redeem on the Nintendo e-shop!

See you in the next post! Bye!

notes.title: Wavecade for Steam releasing this Monday!
notes.notes:
We are 3 days away from releasing Wavecade for Steam! 

I'd like to thank everyone who is currently following the game and has it wish-listed <3. You lot are legends!

Some things to know about the release:

- If you want to buy the game, buy it within the first week since we have a 20% discount for it. In the mean time, please try out the demo and rate the game as it will help us a lot. Tell us what you think of the game and what you would like to see in the future.

- Since the game was hosted on Steam Next Fest in June 22, we did experience some issues regarding the matchmaking multiplayer. These issues are now fixed and there should be no delay when the next wave begins. 

- Wavecade will be available on Nintendo Switch in the e-shop! Release date is not set yet as it is going through the submission procedure with the latest update and bug fixes. If you prefer to play your games on your Switch and on-the-go then this is perfect for you. I will post another announcement when you can get the game on Switch.

- There will be updates to the game once released, and of course bug fixes if or when they are reported. - There already is a v1.1 in the works with major improvements to the gameplay and new cool content such as powerups, abilities, and player customization.

- The game has more configurable visual options if the graphics are a little too eye-melting for you:
  - Bloom intensity
  - Distortion effects
  - VHS/TV effects
  - Sun shafts/God ray effects

- Anyone that would like to speedrun the game or attempt to beat the high scores please post your video attempts and share it to the Steam page or workshop if possible. I am also trying to get Wavecade on speedrun.com


Once again, thank you!

notes.title: Let's Play Wavecade!
notes.notes:
Let's Play WAVECADE!

Wavecade is an arcade shooter where you control the speed of the game. Shoot and collect powerups to advance in levels, gaining loads of points. 

Play arcade mode and co-op with a friend to double your firepower.


While Steam Next Fest June 22 is active, we have many competitive offers:

- Players who download the demo that play single player "Arcade" mode + reach wave 100 will get a Steam Key for the full game.

- Players that sign up at [url=http://wavecade.ml]Wavecade[/url] will be added for double XP when the game is released.

- The current leading scores will have their Steam ID added to a list of players that will automatically achieve double XP when playing the full version of Wavecade when it is released.

- Players that join the discord (from the store page) or follow on Twitter will be added for double XP when the game is released.

- Players that match with the developer, you will be added for double XP when the game is released. 

Please email spalatobros@gmail.com with proof of gameplay to be able to get a Steam Key for the full game.

If you like this game, please add this to your wishlist. All is appreciated.
